messages:
maria_cs: quick one 1: we got reports that some onboarding nudges were sent twice to the same contact yesterday, affecting a few high-value accounts. noticed duplicate contact records too. tagging infra + data to triage. @ryan_data @sam_backend
incidents-bot: [alert] task `playbook_sender` reported duplicate-event warning for event_id=ev_9f3a at 2026-03-21T09:14:02Z
ryan_data: digging into dedupe logs. initial hunch: the canonical mapping job ran concurrently with incremental imports, so two contact IDs existed when the playbook candidate set was computed. the candidate query joins on contact_id, not canonical_contact_id.
sam_backend: we should make the playbook selection use canonical_contact_id. short term I can add a lookup in the sender service to map raw -> canonical during candidate evaluation. that'll catch duplicates until data backfill finishes.
jordan_ops: also recommend a "send history" window de-dup on the sender side: if a contact (canonical) received the same nudge template within X hours, skip. prevents replay and double-send during backfills.
olivia_csm: please make sure enterprise accounts are excluded from auto-sends if they have a high renewal risk or recent manual outreach. the duplicate went to an enterprise pilot cohort and the customer flagged it.
ryan_data: agreed. propose these tasks: 1) change candidate query to canonical_contact_id (fast schema-safe change), 2) run backfill to populate canonical ids for 60 days, 3) add sender-side event-id caching for idempotency, 4) add auto-hold tagging rule for high-risk/enterprise accounts.
ivy_qe: i'll prepare regression cases for the staging smoke: duplicates, contact merges, and hold-tag scenarios. can you provide sample accounts for the staging cohort?
maria_cs: i'll assemble 12 staging accounts (mix of enterprise/pilot/mid-market) and post IDs. also want a manual-review flow for accounts with hold tag: either queue to CSMs or send only after manual clearance.
sam_backend: timeline: I can get candidate-query change + sender idempotency in tomorrow's deploy (10:00 UTC). will gate the change behind FF `playbook_canonical_map` so we can revert quickly. backfill will be separate and run during off-peak.
jordan_ops: SQL for hold tagging suggestion: `update accounts set auto_nudge_hold = true where account_tier = 'Enterprise' or renewal_score >= 0.75;` we can refine with `last_manual_touch` criteria after initial rollout.
ryan_data: I'll run a dry backfill and share delta counts. If >2k mappings we will chunk the backfill to avoid impacting downstream services. dashboard link: https://dash.internal.redwood/queries/backfill-estimate (posting results soon).
olivia_csm: thanks team. once staging smoke passes, we'll flip FF for 10% of prod accounts for one day and monitor `nudge_failures` and `duplicate_sends`. please tag me on the status updates. :thumbsup:
maria_cs: perfect. owners: sam_backend (deploy + FF), ryan_data (backfill + mapping), ivy_qe (smoke/regressions), olivia_csm (enablement + approval). will follow up with the account list and timeline. thanks everyone! :pray:
